title: Retrospective Investigation of Circadian Disruption and Clinical Phenotypes in ICU Patients with COVID-19 (CP-COVID-19)
summary: Many COVID-19 patients treated in intensive care units experienced delirium, a state of sudden confusion, yet the biological causes of this condition remain unclear. This study aims to better understand this condition by tracking changes in vital signs over time, identifying various biological patterns of the syndrome using laboratory values, and investigating how nutritional care affects specific mineral levels. By researching these underlying processes, the hope is to achieve more personalized and effective care for critically ill patients.
conditions: Delirium not superimposed on dementia, so described

interventions.name: This retrospective project includes the analyses of 3 working packages of COVID-19 patients who were treated in the intensive care units of Charité - Universitätsmedizin Berlin between 01.01.2020 and 21.02.2022 (and follow-up + 180 days).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- All patients with COVID-19 disease, proven by positive PCR tests from nasal / throat swab and samples from the deep respiratory tract. 
- Period 01.01.2020 to 21.02.2022
Exclusion criteria:
•	None
